measurement.scale: one coordinate unit assumed one meter; physical calibration unverified
measurement.sceneAuthority: Host-issued document/revision/view; refuse stale or unresolved displayed centers.

agent.enable: Copy current connection prompt and tell the user to paste into their agent terminal.

selection.undo: Undo latest selection action including unfinished gesture.
selection.rightClick: Clear first; exit if already empty; drag pans.

save: Native human overwrite warns; API and web exports create a new copy. Failed admission preserves document/history.

paint.manual: Choose task, draw, release to preview, inspect, Apply or discard. One pending stroke; each changed Apply is one Standard history entry.
paint.cancel: X/Ctrl+Z discards pending stroke and stays armed. Idle Undo/Redo reaches history. Escape/plain right click discards first, exits from idle; a drag pans.
paint.hiddenTools: Retain released pending work and fixed review actions; suspend input. Resolve to navigation while hidden.
paint.target: Explicit Scene or Selection, remembered per document; empty Selection never broadens. Freeze target/protection and captured view per stroke.
paint.placement: Surface-following immutable render snapshot; stop at the first unsupported depth and preview only the valid prefix. Budget/worker/fit failure remains atomic.
paint.colorEligibility: Target and writable members intersect spherical center hits and significant rendered contributors inside the captured stroke footprint, never whole-frame visibility alone.
paint.inspection: Released camera inspection/resize never reprojects or widens a stroke.
paint.appearance: Clean preview and applied appearance; preserve stored DC/SH conventions and restore display preferences on exit.
paint.ownership: Existing controller/worker/admission/publication/history. Agent actions are direct/proposal operations without human Apply approval. Clone and technical generation parameters remain API-only.
